addition: The crop-based models in Stages 4--6 classify each candidate using a local video window. Padding supplies nearby context, but the window may omit road structure or other agents elsewhere in the image. This motivates a separate full-frame feature path that relates the candidate to the wider scene. We compare uniform averaging of scene features with attention that weights them according to the candidate.
